## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `ApiRateLimiting`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `api-rate-limiting`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **ApiRateLimiting**.

## Step 2: Enable rate limiting for an API

1. <!-- manual: Sign in to the [WSO2 Cloud](https://console.devant.dev/). -->
2. <!-- manual: In the Project Overview page, select an integration as API for which you want to apply rate limiting. -->
3. On the preferred environment card, select **Configure**.
4. Select **Next** to view **Endpoint Details**.
5. <!-- manual: Click the settings icon. -->
6. In the **Manage** section, select **Rate Limiting** to expand it.
7. Select **a **Rate Limiting Level** based on your requirements**.
8. Select **Apply**.
